'''Skid Lake''' was a lake formed on the world of [[Innton II]] that was created by the crash of the ''[[Nova Defiant/Legends|Nova Defiant]]''. [[Poison/Legends|Toxins]] leached out of the ship, poisoning the lake.<ref name="Strongholds" />
